properties.location: 8800 block of Chester Forest Lane (Treemont subdivision), North Chesterfield
properties.what: Pedestrian crash: a 19-year-old man and a 12-year-old were struck by a car around 1:52 a.m. following a disturbance in the 8800 block of Chester Forest Lane during a Halloween party. Both were taken to a hospital; the man died and the child's injuries were non-life-threatening. Chesterfield Police are investigating the death as suspicious. A Nov. 4 court document identified the driver as 19-year-old Jorvin Gonzalez Del Cid, charged in the hit-and-run; officers said he had bloodshot eyes, slurred speech and the smell of alcohol, refused a breathalyzer, and the truck was later found at a church off Beulah Road with beer bottles on the floorboard. A witness told police he saw the truck run over the boy, who suffered a brain bleed, broken femur and dislocated hip. Del Cid is due back in court Jan. 6, 2027. A Nov. 5 WRIC report on the criminal complaint identifies the man killed as Arturo Luna-Ortiz and lists the charges against Del Cid — DUI, maiming resulting from driving while intoxicated, hit-and-run resulting in injury and refusal to take a breath test, all tied to the 12-year-old’s injuries; no charges have been filed in Luna-Ortiz’s death, Del Cid is being held without bond, and police are working to identify the people involved in the reported attack.

properties.location: Idlewood Road & Harrison Road

The outage left residents in the Museum District, the Fan, Northside and VCU buildings with low or no water pressure, though officials said a boil-water advisory was unlikely. Police said the crash occurred near the 400 block of South Harrison Street and that the driver fled the scene but was later located, arrested and charged with hit-and-run; power was restored to the pump station around 8:40 p.m. Nov. 2 and DPU said the water was safe to drink as pressure returned to normal (NBC12).

properties.location: East Main Street & 21st Street (Shockoe Bottom)
properties.what: Pedestrian hit-and-run: a 75-year-old Richmond man was struck by a work van heading east on East Main Street near the 21st Street intersection around 10:15 a.m. He was taken to a local hospital where he later died. Police said the driver left the scene before officers arrived; investigators collected surveillance video from nearby businesses and used "other investigative techniques" to identify the vehicle and driver. They arrested John McSparren, 47, of North Chesterfield, and charged him with felony hit-and-run. Workers in the area told CBS 6 the van dragged the victim about halfway up the block before he came free, and said the Main Street/Shockoe Bottom intersection has long been a safety concern (one had flagged it in the city's Pedestrian Safety Master Plan survey). Richmond-area musicians later mourned him as a fixture of the local open mic scene, where he performed under the stage name "Gerry" at Rare Olde Times. WRIC noted the Main Street/21st Street intersection is part of the city's high-injury network and said this was the 11th pedestrian crash 8News had reported in Richmond this year, six of them deadly and six hit-and-runs; the Richmond Department of Transportation said every loss of life on city streets underscores the urgency of its Vision Zero work.
properties.fatalities: 1 (Harry Laverty, 75, of Richmond; died at hospital)

Both people in the SUV were pronounced dead at the scene at approximately 6:30 a.m., according to Virginia State Police, whose Crash Reconstruction Team is assisting. On Monday, Nov. 9, state police identified them as Alexander Lloyd Chaplin, 38, and Jack Philip Oppenheim, 27, both of Henrico County; Oppenheim was the founder of the Capital Run Club, which confirmed his death in a social media post. On Nov. 12, more than 100 people took part in a community walk in Richmond along the Capitol Run Club's usual route to honor Oppenheim, starting in Scott's Addition; his family said it plans to create a foundation in his name to provide scholarships.

properties.location: I-95 northbound near the Seventh Street overpass (vehicle landed on the entrance ramp from North 7th Street to I-95 northbound)
properties.what: Single-vehicle crash: Virginia State Police were dispatched at 8:38 p.m. to a single-vehicle crash on I-95 northbound near the Seventh Street overpass. Preliminary information indicates the vehicle was traveling at a high rate of speed when it ran off the right side of the interstate and went airborne, striking a VDOT sign and clearing a guardrail while still airborne before hitting the Seventh Street overpass and landing in the middle of the entrance ramp from Seventh Street to I-95 northbound. A woman was thrown from the vehicle and taken to a hospital with life-threatening injuries; several Good Samaritans stopped and ran to the overturned wreckage to help.

properties.location: 9300 block of Hickory Hill Road, Hanover County
properties.what: Single-vehicle fatal crash: Hanover County Sheriff's Office deputies responded at about 5:40 a.m. Saturday, Nov. 14 to the 9300 block of Hickory Hill Road for a single-vehicle crash. The preliminary investigation found an SUV traveling west on Hickory Hill Road ran off the road and struck a tree. Deputies arrived to find the vehicle engulfed in flames; officials said the damage was "catastrophic" and they could not identify the make or model of the SUV. The remains of a single occupant were found in the driver seat. The driver has not been identified. The crash remains under investigation.
properties.sources: WTVR CBS 6; NBC12 (WWBT); WRIC 8News; Richmond Times-Dispatch

properties.location: Ramp from Route 288 South to Interstate 95 South, Chesterfield County
properties.what: Police pursuit crash: a police chase that began with a domestic-related call and traveled through multiple jurisdictions along Interstate 95 and Route 288 ended when the vehicle crashed on the ramp from Route 288 South to Interstate 95 South. The ramp was blocked off for the investigation and has since reopened to traffic. Officers detained two people at the scene; Virginia Statewide Incidents reported one of them was evaluated by EMS for a dog bite, while Chesterfield County Police told 12 On Your Side no one was injured.
properties.injuries: None reported by police; one person evaluated by EMS for a dog bite (per Virginia Statewide Incidents)

properties.location: 9700 block of Midlothian Turnpike (store frontage)
properties.what: Single-vehicle crash into a building: a car crashed into a store in the 9700 block of Midlothian Turnpike around 1:30 p.m. Sunday afternoon, according to Chesterfield Police. One person who was inside the building was taken to a hospital; police said the driver was not injured. The crash remains under investigation.
properties.injuries: 1 (person inside the building transported to a hospital; police reported no injuries)

properties.location: 1200 block of Kingscross Road, Midlothian
properties.what: Single-vehicle crash into a residence: Virginia Statewide Incidents said a vehicle crashed into a home at 7:38 p.m. Monday evening, Nov. 16, in the 1200 block of Kingscross Road. The homeowner said she heard an extremely loud noise and thought her house was collapsing; her 80-year-old mother's bedroom is directly where the vehicle struck, and her mother was not injured. It remains unclear whether any charges will be filed.
properties.injuries: None reported (the 80-year-old mother whose bedroom was struck was not injured)

properties.location: Intersection of Turner Road and Elkhardt Road (Manchester area)
properties.what: Three-vehicle crash: a Chesterfield County Public Schools bus (Bus 695) traveling east on Elkhardt Road collided with a motorcycle heading south on Turner Road; the motorcycle and rider then struck a white Chevrolet Suburban traveling north on Turner Road approaching Elkhardt Road. Students were on the bus at the time but none were injured, and another school bus took them to school. All drivers remained at the scene and cooperated with police. The intersection was cleared and reopened.
properties.sources: WTVR CBS 6; NBC12 (WWBT); WRIC 8News; Richmond Times-Dispatch; Hoodline

properties.location: West Hundred Road & Rivers Bend Road (Chester area)
properties.what: Bicyclist struck by a vehicle: Chesterfield County Police responded at 11:29 p.m. Saturday to West Hundred Road and Rivers Bend Road for reports of a bicyclist who had been struck by a vehicle. Officers found the bicyclist, who was taken to a local hospital. The driver of the vehicle remained on the scene, according to officials.

properties.location: 5000 block of Forest Hill Avenue (near Mexico Restaurant, in front of Publix and Goodwill), Richmond
properties.what: Two-vehicle crash involving a car and a motorcycle: Richmond Police were called to the 5000 block of Forest Hill Avenue just after 8:30 p.m. and found the motorcyclist, an adult man, with significant injuries. He was taken to a local hospital, where he later died; his identity has not been released. The driver of the car stayed at the scene, and the Richmond Police Department's Crash Team is investigating. Police ask anyone with information to call RPD at 804-646-5100 or Crime Stoppers at 804-780-1000.
properties.injuries: 1 (motorcyclist, transported with significant injuries, later died)
properties.sources: WTVR CBS 6; NBC12 (WWBT); WRIC 8News; Richmond Times-Dispatch
properties.geo_how: Mexico Restaurant, Forest Hill Avenue, Richmond

properties.location: Lauderdale Drive & West Broad Street, Henrico
properties.what: Pedestrian crash: Henrico Police were called around 9:15 p.m. for a report of a person hit by a vehicle at Lauderdale Drive and West Broad Street and found an adult woman showing signs of trauma. She was taken to an area hospital with serious injuries. The Henrico Police Crash Team took over the investigation, and drivers in the area were told to expect lane closures while officers worked. Police said the investigation is ongoing; no charges were announced.

properties.location: West Broad Street, Henrico
properties.what: A DUI hit-and-run driver struck and killed a disabled JR Tucker High School student who was walking along the side of West Broad Street in Henrico County. A driver was subsequently arrested and charged in the crash.
